# Rice & Spice

> Sushi Restaurant in Tampa, Florida. Rolls reviewers call super fresh, Laos ceviche, Tipsy Noodle and a sushi bar, with Thai and Chinese dishes beside them.

- Phone: (813) 475-6955
- Address: 11625 Sheldon Rd, Tampa, FL 33626
- Areas: Tampa, Temple Terrace, Carrollwood, Town 'n' Country
- Offers: Sushi rolls; Sashimi and nigiri; Noodles and rice
- Rating: 4.8 from 564 Google reviews
